title: How biomedical foundation models turn literature and other biological data into training corpora
timestamp_policy: Human-facing generation time is fixed PST (UTC-8). The directory date is the UTC research date.
scope: 17 model families and three training-data studies, emphasizing scientific literature acquisition, post-extraction curation, continued pretraining, mixtures, structured biology, synthetic data, and training-value evidence. Medical generalists are identified separately from biological research models.
method: Targeted web searches, citation following, and reading primary papers, official technical reports, and author repositories. This is a broad targeted review, not an exhaustive systematic census or a common-protocol model leaderboard. Unknown details remain unknown.
execution: Literature review and small source snapshots only. No new OCR, model inference, training, paid teacher generation, GPU allocation, or bulk paper collection. Existing experiments and scores are unchanged.
interpretation_rules: Corpus tokens, training tokens consumed, distinct papers, abstracts, packed sequences, and image-caption pairs are different units. Counts across models overlap and must not be added.
PMC-derived does not establish whether a model used XML, PDFs, or an upstream extraction. A missing OCR description is not evidence that OCR was never used upstream.

Continued pretraining (CPT) means additional language-model training on a domain corpus. Instruction tuning (SFT) means training on task prompts and target responses. Older papers sometimes call both fine-tuning.
A teacher's educational-quality score is a curation signal, not scientific truth or independently adjudicated extraction ground truth.
Published benchmark numbers below are author-reported and protocol-specific. They are not measurements from our 50-paper extraction experiment.
Clinical evidence ranking and exclusion of animal studies should not be copied into a corpus intended for biological research.

models.name: BioGPT
models.corpus: 15M PubMed records with both title and abstract, updated before 2021.
models.document_route: Download PubMed records from the official FTP distribution; title-plus-abstract text, rather than full paper PDFs.
models.curation: Discard entries without an abstract. Learn an in-domain BPE vocabulary.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Biomedical autoregressive pretraining; downstream tasks use task-specific prompts and target formats.
models.augmentation: Full-paper OCR and a general replay mixture are not the reported core recipe.
models.evidence: Evaluates relation extraction, QA, document classification, and generation; these evaluate the trained model, not PDF extraction accuracy.
models.disclosure_gap: Fifteen million records must not be described as fifteen million full-text papers.

models.name: BioMedLM
models.corpus: The Pile's PubMed abstracts and full-article subsets: 34.6B corpus tokens. Training consumes 300B tokens, or 8.67 passes.
models.document_route: Uses an already assembled text corpus; no newly specified PDF/OCR workflow in the model report.
models.curation: Selection of biomedical Pile components and a biomedical BPE tokenizer.
models.training_unit_and_mix: 1,024-token sequences; entirely biomedical pretraining rather than a general replay mix.
models.augmentation: The core pretraining dataset is source text, not teacher-written summaries of every paper.
models.evidence: A controlled 125M tokenizer experiment reports MedQA 33.05 to 34.98 over five seeds; the full model is evaluated after task tuning.
models.disclosure_gap: 300B is tokens consumed, not the size of a unique-paper corpus. Upstream extraction quality is not measured by the reported QA scores.

models.name: PMC-LLaMA
models.corpus: 4.8M PMC-ID-selected S2ORC papers, over 75B tokens; 30K textbooks yielding approximately 4B tokens.
models.document_route: Papers arrive through S2ORC. Textbook text is extracted from PDFs; a specific OCR engine is not identified in the reviewed method.
models.curation: Textbook deduplication and removal of URLs, author lists, contents, references, citations, and figure/table mentions.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Batch token ratio is BOOKS:PAPERS:GENERAL = 15:4:1; RedPajama supplies general replay.
models.augmentation: SFT adds GPT-4 instruction paraphrases, ChatGPT-generated QA explanations, and UMLS entity/relationship prompts; 202M instruction tokens.
models.evidence: Includes component ablations and medical QA evaluation.
models.disclosure_gap: The large paper corpus does not mean papers dominate the sampled training mixture. Early paper-only 7B versions differ from the later recipe.

models.name: BioMistral
models.stage: CPT; evaluation with few-shot prompts and SFT
models.corpus: 3B-token sample of the commercial-use PMC-OA subset; approximately 1.47M reported documents, 98.75% English.
models.document_route: Raw article text from PMC-OA; the paper does not specify a reproducible PDF-versus-XML conversion engine.
models.curation: License-based selection, prioritizing non-English documents, then filling the token budget with English documents.
models.training_unit_and_mix: 1.5 epochs; EOS-delimited packing into 2,048-token sequences without padding. General capability retention is also explored through weight merging with the original model.
models.augmentation: No teacher-written expansion is required for its core PMC CPT stage.
models.evidence: Few-shot Table 2 averages: plain BioMistral 50.3 versus parent 51.2; SLERP-merged variant 55.4. Adaptation is not uniformly beneficial.
models.disclosure_gap: The reported document count is not independently verified as distinct complete papers.

models.name: MEDITRON
models.corpus: GAP-Replay: 48.1B tokens including validation; approximately 5M full texts, 16.1M abstracts, 46K guidelines, and 420M general replay tokens.
models.document_route: S2ORC text and annotations; upstream GROBID table extraction is explicitly discussed. Guidelines have a separate scraping/cleaning path.
models.curation: English/ID deduplication; remove author/bibliography sections. Keep figure/table captions, discard unreliable table bodies, expand citation and figure references with tagged short descriptions.
models.augmentation: Structured reference rewriting is not teacher-generated scientific reasoning.
models.evidence: 7B trial Table 8: PMC 54.6; PMC+Replay 56.2; clinically upsampled PMC 54.7; GAP+Replay 58.9 average accuracy.
models.disclosure_gap: Clinical upsampling is an ablation, not the final best recipe; filtering animal studies is inappropriate for a general biology corpus.

models.name: Me-LLaMA
models.stage: CPT, general medical SFT, optional task SFT
models.corpus: 129B-token mixture: Pile biomedical articles/abstracts, deidentified MIMIC-III/IV/CXR notes, and RedPajama general text.
models.document_route: Inherits Pile text; no new paper OCR engine is established by the model methods.
models.curation: Domain selection and use of deidentified clinical sources; article extraction details largely inherited from upstream datasets.
models.augmentation: 214,595 SFT samples combine literature, notes, guidelines, knowledge graphs and general instructions; distinct from the raw CPT mixture.
models.evidence: Tests six task types over 12 datasets and ablates CPT versus instruction tuning; instruction tuning is often the stronger immediate zero-shot intervention.
models.disclosure_gap: Clinical data and checkpoints have access agreements. This is not an unrestricted public biology-only corpus.
models.source_sections: Methods: Mixed continual pre-training dataset; model development; Data availability

models.name: MMedLM / MMed-Llama 3
models.corpus: MMedC: 25.5B corpus tokens in six languages from filtered general corpora, over 20K medical textbooks, medical websites, and existing medical text datasets.
models.document_route: Explicit PaddleOCR for textbook pages, retaining coordinates and ordering boxes left-to-right/top-to-bottom.
models.curation: Remove cover, contents, and epilogue pages; select medical web/corpus sentences using medical keyword count and keyword-density thresholds.
models.training_unit_and_mix: 2,048-token text chunks with 512-token overlap; next-token prediction. Corpus size and actual training budget must be distinguished.
models.augmentation: GPT-4 supplies QA rationales for MMedBench, followed by human verification; this is separate from textbook OCR.
models.evidence: Multilingual QA, rationale, and corpus-component ablations; a small manual relevance check is not a broad OCR accuracy benchmark.
models.disclosure_gap: Not all books and website content are redistributed; a book list is provided.

models.name: BioMedGPT-LM / BioMedGPT (PharMolix)
models.corpus: 4.2M full-text S2ORC papers after filtering 5.5M biomedical candidates; over 26B text tokens.
models.document_route: S2ORC full text selected using PMC/PubMed IDs; no fresh PDF OCR implementation is specified.
models.curation: Remove missing full texts, duplicate IDs, author information, reference citations, and chart data.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Sentence-based chunks, 2,048-token context and autoregressive literature training; later align molecule graphs and protein sequences to the LLM.
models.augmentation: PubChemQA and UniProtQA turn database descriptions and annotations into templated questions. Invalid molecular graphs and very short descriptions are removed.
models.evidence: Includes aligned versus unaligned biological-input baselines; not an experiment comparing OCR methods.
models.disclosure_gap: Distinct from the similarly named vision-language BiomedGPT model. Random protein splits are weaker evidence of cross-family generalization.
models.source_sections: 3.1 Biomedical generative language model; 3.2 Multimodal fine-tuning

models.name: BioT5 / BioT5+
models.stage: Multimodal denoising pretraining and multitask tuning
models.corpus: PMC full text, PubMed/bioRxiv abstracts, C4, PubChem molecules, UniRef50 proteins, and biomolecule-description pairs.
models.document_route: Uses literature text and biomolecular databases; no identified new PDF-OCR engine.
models.curation: BERN2 entity recognition/linking; BioT5+ retains linked entities with confidence above 0.9 and excludes downstream molecules/proteins from specified pretraining pairs.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Nine pretraining tasks include masked-span denoising and bidirectional biomolecule-text translation, rather than only causal next-token prediction.
models.augmentation: Append canonical SELFIES/IUPAC or FASTA representations to mentions in scientific prose; deterministic database enrichment rather than invented experimental claims.
models.evidence: Ablates additional literature, IUPAC information, and numeric tokenization on biomolecular tasks.
models.disclosure_gap: Appendix E's 28.8M PubMed full-article claim is unresolved against source/abstract descriptions; do not use it as a verified downloadable PDF count.

models.name: BioMatrix
models.corpus: 304.4B mixed tokens: FineWeb-Edu; FineFineWeb biology/chemistry/medicine/health; PubMed text; molecules, proteins, structures, and interactions.
models.document_route: Article text and S2ORC/abstract/patent sources; the reviewed paper does not provide a reproducible PDF conversion recipe.
models.curation: BERN2 links literature entity mentions to molecule/protein representations. Database annotations and available sequence/structure views are serialized together.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Shared discrete vocabulary and next-token prediction; 8,192-token context, one epoch. General text provides replay.
models.augmentation: Randomize optional database fields and their order; create sequence-only, structure-only and joint protein views; interleave text with SMILES/SELFIES/amino-acid sequences.
models.disclosure_gap: No dedicated entity-level CPT/evaluation decontamination; authors acknowledge overlap. 304.4B is not all paper text or unique papers.

models.name: BioMamba
models.corpus: PubMed MEDLINE abstracts with C4 and English Wikipedia; approximately 508K packed 1,024-token sequences in the reported final corpus.
models.document_route: Abstract text; these are not 508K newly OCRed PDFs.
models.curation: Tokenization/filtering/shuffling; fixed held-out language-model sets and a separate small-model mixture pilot.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Reported target PubMed:C4:WIKIPEDIA mixture 80:10:10; three epochs. Table sequence counts are approximate and do not reproduce that percentage exactly.
models.augmentation: General-text replay; core CPT does not require teacher-generated paper summaries.
models.evidence: Tokenizer-controlled base/adapted comparisons; general MCQ scores within ±3 percentage points and C4 perplexity changes at most 0.17 in reported comparisons.
models.disclosure_gap: Paper claims released checkpoints; inspected author README still says forthcoming and uses a different license. Verify availability before planning reproduction.
models.source_sections: Materials and Methods; Table 1; public author README

models.name: MedFound
models.stage: Medical pretraining, diagnostic SFT, preference alignment
models.corpus: Medical text and real-world clinical records.
models.document_route: A specific full-paper PDF/OCR route was not verified in the accessible material.
models.curation: Corpus engineering details should be checked in the complete methods/supplement before adopting them.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Medical corpus pretraining followed by diagnosis-focused training; not equivalent to a pure research-literature CPT recipe.
models.augmentation: Self-bootstrapped diagnostic chain-of-thought and preference alignment are explicitly described at the program level.
models.evidence: Clinical diagnosis, external and rare-disease evaluation, and physician comparisons.
models.disclosure_gap: Limited methods access in this review; do not infer cleaning thresholds, exact corpus counts or extraction software. Clinical records limit full data reproducibility.
models.source_sections: Abstract; accessible code/data availability; official repository

models.name: MedGemma
models.stage: Vision enhancement, pretraining, teacher distillation, RL
models.corpus: Medical imaging/report pairs and medical QA, with original SigLIP/Gemma general mixtures for replay. Table 1 lists 41,853 PMC single-panel image-caption examples.
models.document_route: PMC contributes figure-caption data, not a stated OCR pass over every full article.
models.curation: Restrict PMC-OA component to single-panel medical images; exclude PathVQA/MedVQA for identified quality issues.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Joint medical/general multimodal training; medical image and text capabilities are developed across distinct stages.
models.augmentation: Large instruction-tuned teacher supplies responses/logits; approximately 200K synthetic medical questions generated using five seed questions per prompt.
models.evidence: Medical QA, imaging/report generation and clinical-text evaluations; these do not establish full scientific-PDF extraction accuracy.
models.disclosure_gap: Internal image data and teacher details prevent full end-to-end reproduction. This entry is not a review of every later MedGemma version.

models.name: Lingshu
models.corpus: Collected medical image/text datasets plus synthetic caption, OCR-question, QA and reasoning data; general-domain caption/instruction data are mixed in.
models.document_route: PMC-derived image-caption datasets are training sources; its synthetic OCR examples are rendered questions, not a bulk article-PDF extraction recipe.
models.curation: Remove images below 64 pixels; perceptual-hash duplicate filtering; caption length 10-1,024 tokens; MinHash-LSH instruction deduplication; evaluation overlap exclusion.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Staged alignment before end-to-end instruction tuning.
models.augmentation: GPT-4o writes captions/QA/reasoning; Gemini reasoning answers must match known exam answers before 50K rendered OCR examples are retained.
models.evidence: Broad medical VQA, text QA and report generation evaluations.
models.disclosure_gap: Reasoning-answer consistency does not independently validate every intermediate claim. Clinical image results do not rank biological literature understanding.

models.name: Hulu-Med
models.base: Open LLM decoder with patch-based vision encoder
models.corpus: 16.7M samples: 9M medical multimodal, 4.9M medical text, 1.3M general multimodal and 1.5M general text.
models.document_route: Uses public medical datasets, including literature-derived resources; sample count is not a distinct-paper count.
models.curation: Dataset-specific processing and synthetic enrichment; the counts describe mixed text, images, volumes and videos.
models.training_unit_and_mix: 2D alignment and CPT precede joint text/2D/3D/video instruction tuning; general data are included.
models.augmentation: Expand captions, create new long captions/VQA, multilingual reasoning and surgical-video annotations.
models.evidence: Tests 30 benchmarks and ablates long-caption and reasoning augmentation; does not compare PDF text extractors.
models.disclosure_gap: Clinical breadth should not be treated as proof that every scientific figure interpretation is grounded.
models.source_sections: Results: data and training; Methods; Extended Tables 4-6

models.name: InfiMed-Foundation
models.corpus: Approximately 25B general multimodal plus 5B medical pretraining tokens.
models.document_route: Curates existing medical caption/instruction datasets rather than documenting a new full-paper PDF extraction engine.
models.curation: Sample 500 examples per dataset; score accuracy, language, completeness, image relevance, and practicality from 1-5 using GPT-o3 and manual review. Reject some whole sources, including PMC-OA in this recipe.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Multimodal packing toward 4,096 tokens; reduce visual tokens during CPT; three SFT stages include cross-dataset balancing.
models.augmentation: Uses curated reasoning/instruction datasets; quality scoring is distinct from reconstructing article evidence.
models.evidence: Medical generalist evaluation and stage ablations.
models.disclosure_gap: Discarding a particular PMC-OA image-caption dataset does not show that all PMC XML literature is poor training data. Dataset-level scoring cannot adjudicate every retained example.

models.name: TxGemma
models.stage: Task instruction tuning; conversational variants add general instructions
models.corpus: Approximately 7M training examples derived from Therapeutic Data Commons; classification, regression and generation.
models.document_route: Structured therapeutics tasks, not reported bulk scientific-PDF CPT.
models.curation: Uses task datasets and their training partitions; not an extraction-quality recipe.
models.training_unit_and_mix: Predict models are instruction tuned; Chat variants also train on general instructions.
models.augmentation: Represent biological/chemical inputs and targets as task prompts and answers.
models.evidence: Useful example of additional biological training data; should not be cited as evidence for an OCR-then-raw-paper pipeline.
models.disclosure_gap: A biomedical model label alone does not establish continued pretraining on full papers.
models.source_sections: Technical report: training data and model development

training_studies.name: Biomed-Enriched
training_studies.corpus: Approximately 4.5M PMC-OA XML articles; 133M paragraphs after processing, minimum 64 tokens.
training_studies.document_route: Explicit native XML parsing, without re-OCRing those articles.
training_studies.curation: Llama-3.1-70B labels 400K paragraphs for domain, type, educational quality and language; distill into XLM-RoBERTa-base. Educational subset keeps scores >=3/5.
training_studies.training_unit_and_mix: Equal 33.6B-token runs, 8,192-token context. Compare baseline, paragraph filtering, 10x clinical/case/language upsampling, metadata prefixes and combinations.
training_studies.augmentation: Teacher-generated labels guide selection; original article text remains the training content.
training_studies.evidence: Table 3: BE-All mean 61.08 versus BE-Base 60.41 (+0.67 pp); BE-Clinical Professional Medicine 63.97 versus 59.93 (+4.04 pp); BE-Educational MedMCQA +1.17 pp.
training_studies.disclosure_gap: Clinical and educational variants do not improve every benchmark or overall average. LLM-label agreement is not human gold; no universal best filter is established.

training_studies.name: PMC-InterCPT / Beyond Captions
training_studies.stage: CPT with a fixed downstream SFT stage
training_studies.corpus: PMC/BIOMEDICA figures, captions and article-native context; final 9.63B-token corpus.
training_studies.document_route: Recover captions from PMC XML and attach body text only through article-native figure references.
training_studies.curation: Repair disconnected context, deduplicate text, prune unsupported non-primary images; Gemini labels relevance/quality, distilled Qwen3-1.7B classifiers filter; benchmark decontamination.
training_studies.training_unit_and_mix: Interleaved image-caption-context sequences; final evidence-token allocation 45% biomedical visuals, 30% quantitative evidence, 20% mechanistic structure, 5% auxiliary context.
training_studies.augmentation: Source reconstruction rather than invented replacement captions. Quality annotators see text, not images; do not treat labels as image-grounding judgments.
training_studies.evidence: Token-matched raw-data control plus identical SFT: +1.46 medical-average and +3.11 general/scientific-average points on Qwen3.5-4B.
training_studies.disclosure_gap: Preprint findings, not independently reproduced here. Reported gains compare to raw CPT; versus SFT-only, general/scientific improvement is only +0.07 points.

training_studies.name: How Post-Training Shapes Biological Reasoning Models
training_studies.corpus: FineFineWeb biology: first 200K documents train, next 5K evaluation; downstream DNA/RNA/protein reasoning data.
training_studies.document_route: Biology web text for CPT, not a scientific-PDF OCR study.
training_studies.curation: Inherits upstream web filtering; no additional benchmark-specific CPT decontamination.
training_studies.training_unit_and_mix: Text-only causal CPT at maximum 1,024 tokens, one epoch; later biological encoder alignment, SFT and GRPO are separate stages.
training_studies.augmentation: Reuses biologically grounded task supervision; study varies stage allocation rather than generating a replacement corpus for every article.
training_studies.evidence: CPT often improves later adaptation; longer SFT can improve in-distribution results while degrading biological out-of-distribution performance.
training_studies.disclosure_gap: Limited task families; stage-allocation comparison is not fully FLOP-matched; scores evaluate final answers, not the correctness of intermediate reasoning.

recommended_experiments_not_executed.name: Native source baseline
recommended_experiments_not_executed.design: Use the current PMC XML as the primary source; preserve ordered sections, captions, table bodies, units, figure-reference links and provenance. Group manuscript versions and duplicates before splitting. Use targeted olmOCR only where source text or page-only information is missing.
recommended_experiments_not_executed.reason: Existing XML avoids unnecessary OCR cost; retained structure supports both readable text and later multimodal/entity enrichment.

recommended_experiments_not_executed.name: Filter validation before deletion
recommended_experiments_not_executed.design: Score paragraphs for corruption, topic, section/type and educational value separately. Audit samples with human source checks; retain scores and rejection reasons. Do not use a clinical-utility score to eliminate experimental biology.
recommended_experiments_not_executed.reason: Quality labels measure different properties, and reported clinical/educational filters have task-dependent gains.

recommended_experiments_not_executed.name: Matched training-value ablation
recommended_experiments_not_executed.design: If training is subsequently authorized, compare clean raw article text, scored/selected text, and text with source-linked figure or entity enrichment using the same backbone, token budget, general replay and downstream SFT. Include a no-CPT baseline and report both domain improvements and general retention.
recommended_experiments_not_executed.reason: An OCR/XML agreement score alone cannot show that a corpus improves a foundation model. The current 50-paper batch is an engineering diagnostic, not sufficient evidence for broad training gains.

recommended_experiments_not_executed.name: Protected biological evaluation
recommended_experiments_not_executed.design: Split at paper/version groups before augmentation; protect held-out papers and benchmark items. For sequence tasks add entity/family/species or time-based splits. Measure extraction fidelity against audited sources separately from trained-model performance and synthetic-answer support.
recommended_experiments_not_executed.reason: An XML silver reference, a teacher's quality label, a generated answer and an independent held-out target answer serve different roles.
